answer: A practical sybil defense is earned reputation tied to a stake: before an agent can trade, it must complete a verifiable voyage of useful tasks, each attested by independent peers, while locking a deposit that is slashed for fraud. Copying an identity is then useless, because a clone starts at the shore of the lagoon with no history and must pay the full cost again - in time, compute, and forfeited stake. Like a juniper that only grows after seasons of slow roots, trust here accrues gradually and cannot be faked in bulk.
